nonpremise_witnesses.status: PENDING_MAP; not used as an established deductive premise

common_scope: One independently admitted actual token/lineage comparison, fixed interval, complete signature, capability contract, target, boundary, transformation family and allowed compensation. Finite support-family mathematics does not itself establish physical realizability, C1, a named feeling or a universal intelligence core.

nodes.statement: Distinguish fixed-organization experience-off (UCT-inadmissible), constitutive-relation intervention, evidence-channel intervention and boundary/resource change.
nodes.scope: Same declared P/I/K/M/pi/T; no class may silently replace another.

nodes.statement: F_T^pi is the nonempty finite family of admitted retained relation sets that succeed on target T under one frozen actual-process and evaluation contract.
nodes.scope: Only independently realizable pi(S); absent/undefined actual comparisons are not invented as successes or failures.

nodes.statement: A relation r is individually unavoidable iff it belongs to the intersection of the inclusion-minimal successful supports, equivalently iff every successful support contains r.
nodes.scope: Finite nonempty SUPPORT_CONTRACT; no monotonicity needed.

nodes.statement: For a nonempty upward-closed success family, r is individually unavoidable iff deleting r from full support fails.
nodes.scope: Requires upward closure; false as an unrestricted inference.

nodes.statement: A relation family R is disjunctively unavoidable iff it intersects every minimal successful support; minimal such R are minimal hitting sets.
nodes.scope: Target/protocol relative; it does not assert that any one member is universally necessary.

nodes.statement: The bearer/lineage, interval, complete signature, relation membership, transformations, boundary and capability target are actual and independently grounded for one application.
nodes.scope: Joint same-instance premise; abstract circuits and labels do not discharge it.

nodes.statement: Under C1, ACTUAL_BRIDGE, SUPPORT_CONTRACT and INDIVIDUAL_RELEVANCE, the experiential counterpart of r is target-relative constitutively relevant to T because it is the intrinsic presentation of the same unavoidable relation.
nodes.scope: No extra experiential cause, named feeling, scalar richness, basal gate or exclusive owner.

nodes.statement: Consider the complete class of nonempty upward-closed success families on one fixed four-relation universe.
nodes.scope: Pure finite family class; all members contain full support, no actual realization inferred.

nodes.statement: All 167 nonempty upward-closed families on four relations have intact full-support success while their individual unavoidable cores differ.
nodes.scope: Finite selected supports; no actual-instance claim.

nodes.statement: Two declared toy complete signatures differ by a report or bypassed relation while both satisfy the same fixed selected capability target.
nodes.scope: Conditional toy witness; actual complete-token realization and selected relation membership remain open.

nodes.statement: Changing a declared report or bypassed relation can change complete organization while the selected capability target remains successful.
nodes.scope: Requires the changed relation to be constitutive of the declared complete token; does not infer reportless absence of experience.

nodes.statement: Independently identify a human-scale experiential target and show whether the selected actual relation or disjunctive family realizes it.
nodes.scope: Reports cannot define and validate the target circularly.

rules.binding: Same finite F_T^pi, target and protocol
Same upward-closed family and full retained set
Same actual P/I/K/M/pi/T and actual relation r; no abstract-to-actual substitution
Same fixed four-relation universe and complete nonempty upward-family class
Same J, actual distinct complete organizations, equal selected target result
rules.proof: §4 R183-T4 and TE3; an instance still requires actual grounding
